description: What Delete or Discard does with a recording, as the phone has it when the question is answered (apps/docs/SPEC.md FR-5.2): one being sent or on its way (going) lands whatever the phone keeps, so it's left. landed is whether the app saw it land, since a missing copy may be one deleted already.
